claimChecks.qualification: Direct current aggregate and task sections preserve Premier Cloud Platform 10.2.x+ with ES 8.6+ in the aggregate versus ES 8.7+ in the task, with paired SOAR and enabled AI Assistant. The task retains existing and previously triaged findings, first ten per detection burst, approximate tenant limit, frontier models and connector, investigation and asset permissions. The older 8.7 task retains its historic name and scope. The 8.8 GA milestone and edition/regional tables establish no new per-agent availability. CMP requires Platform 10.4+, ES 8.8+ and Cloud Connect 2.0+. The earlier same-day indexed prerequisite also specified SAIA 2.4+, retained with its original observation time because the direct setup page remained unavailable. The current SAIA Cloud Connected guidance still excludes 2.2.0–2.3.6, describes 2.1.1 without Agent Mode, and treats 2.4.0 as planned. Exact SOAR pairing, rollout, entitlement and authorization remain separate.
